pages.title: Inflaton Field
pages.text: The field that drove cosmic inflation, stretching the universe exponentially in a fraction of a second. Bottled, it trembles with stored expansion, as if wanting to make everything around it larger. It is hot, restless and very light.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Guth's inflation needs a field to drive it. Distilling dimensional residue at the very top of the spire, I captured a fraction that kept trying to expand its container. The inflaton, caught before it could decay.
